title: 2015 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: The Tigers beat the Sharks \(2\) out of the first \(3\) times they played. They then played \(N\) more times, and the Sharks ended up winning at least \(95\%\) of all the games played. What is the minimum possible value for \(N?\)

solutions.text:
The Sharks won \(1\) of the first \(3\) games. To reach \(95\%\) with the fewest extra games, they should win all \(N\) additional games, giving a win fraction \(\dfrac{1 + N}{3 + N}.\)

Requiring \(\dfrac{1 + N}{3 + N} \ge \dfrac{19}{20}\) gives \(20 + 20N \ge 57 + 19N,\) so \(N \ge 37.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: To minimize \(N,\) let the Sharks win all \(N\) additional games
